issue.title: just lint fails at toobig: src/sase/tool/executor.py has 1168 lines (limit 1000)
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `src/sase/tool/executor.py`

`just toobig` (and therefore `just lint`, which CI's lint and master-gate jobs run) fails deterministically: `VIOLATION: src/sase/tool/executor.py has 1168 lines (limit: 1000)`. Reproduced on clean master `4ee966cd56` with `just toobig`. Line count does not vary between runs, so this is not a flake.

The file was already over the limit before epic sase-18j.10 (1113 lines at `7cb835953`, reported on sase-18j.10 note #1 by sase-17x.13.10.land, attributed to sase-18j.4/.6/.7/.9). Phase sase-18j.10.1 (`ff5412bbb6`) grew it to 1168. `just check` does not run this gate (Justfile: the toobig_split routine owns splits). The E3 landing does not split the file. Proposed by the sase-18j.10 discovered-issue notes.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Static line count. just toobig reports the same 1168-line violation on every run; nothing is timing-dependent.
